## Description {#details}

<p>An <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdnode">SDNode</a> that holds an arbitrary LLVM IR <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/value">Value</a>.</p>


<p>This is used when the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/selectiondag">SelectionDAG</a> needs to make a simple reference to something in the LLVM IR representation.</p>
